## Refactor-relevant observations (evidence-backed)
1. `renderBook`/`renderSection`/`renderExam`/`renderTutorSession` are each invoked from two places, but `obsidian.ts:536` makes the `renderScholarWorkspace` invocation a no-op for those types — a universalized four-engine render layer must first resolve artifact ownership (home+chapter+answer-key vs book+section+exam+tutor).
2. Learn and Tutor already share the question block, figure supplementation, and lesson-record extraction, but their outer note shells (lesson fallback copy, collapsed recap records, status lines, commit warnings) are duplicated near line-for-line in `render/section.ts:198-241` vs `render/assessment.ts:274-311`.
3. Exam rendering is the outlier: its question prompt/answer-region builders live in `exam.ts` (`:263`, `:277`) rather than `render/`, it has three note artifacts instead of one, and it is the only mode excluded from `PRESENTATION_POLICY` (`policies.ts:119-121`), with its presentation rules inlined at `render/assessment.ts:119-131`.
4. `assessmentQuestionBlock` (Learn+Tutor shared projection) is overwritten by `studyDocument` on the production path (`note-records.ts:148-150`), so two question renderers for the same attempt data coexist with only one visible.
summary: Inventory of Scholar's presentation/rendering layer. Two writers project notes: obsidian.ts:renderScholarWorkspace (Scholar Home + chapter notes + answer key) and note-storage.ts:writeNoteBook (book hub + section + exam + tutor notes); obsidian.ts calls renderBook/renderSection/renderExam/renderTutorSession but `writeNote` early-returns for exactly those four note types (obsidian.ts:536), so those calls are no-ops. There are zero mode-string conditionals in the render layer (grep for \bmode\b|session.mode|ScholarMode over render/*, note-records.ts, math-formatting.ts, equation-presentation.ts, obsidian.ts => 'No matches found'); differentiation is by function choice plus note-type/kind discriminators and CSS classes. Learn and Tutor already share assessmentQuestionBlock/supplementalSourceFigureLines/uniqueSupplementLines, but their note skeletons are two hand-maintained copies (render/section.ts:198-231 vs render/assessment.ts:274-302). Exam question rendering lives outside render/ in exam.ts (263, 277) and is re-exported at render/assessment.ts:13. PRESENTATION_POLICY exists once (policies.ts:62-69) and is included by learnInstructions (policies.ts:92) and tutorInstructions (policies.ts:155) but deliberately NOT by examInstructions (policies.ts:115-138) — asserted by tests/verify-scholar-presentation.mjs:87.
